text:
Converting Israeli Driving License (on B1):

Hi everyone, I have an unusual question. I followed each step of the driving license conversion, though I found out about a mistake that happened too late, as there was a twist in the house number of my street - I received the temporary license with the wrong number and also the card will be sent to the wrong number.
We're phoning in circles and every person we speak to says something different, and it seems that they cannot correct the mistake that happened. The last option we were offered is me going to the airport, pay another 177NIS and get it from there.

I was hence wondering if this has happened to anyone and could possibly recommend something as I don't know what's the right thing to do anymore.

Thanks a lot in advance 🙏
